Hi Amy —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a short renewal & expansion coordination thread so we can align stakeholders and timelines. High-level asks from SignalStream I noted: a 20% committed capacity increase, a one-year term extension with a PO-based procurement path, and a QBR in April to review usage and forecast.

Proposed next steps:
- Internal kickoff (Redwood): allocate SE + CSM to provide updated throughput benchmarks for the expanded commit — CC'd Ben and Marissa.
- Shared doc: I attached a draft of the proposed terms with the updated commit and updated pricing (redwood_proposed_terms_v2.docx).
- Procurement: please confirm your procurement timeline so we can schedule signature/DocuSign.
- QBR: suggest the week of Apr 6 for a 60–75 minute QBR (usage review + capacity planning).

If that all looks correct, can you confirm decision owners on your side (legal/procurement/CTO) and preferred QBR dates? I’ll pull a mutual action plan together once we have those.

Thanks,

Hi Amy —

Thanks for the quick reply and the PO template, Rajiv. We can accommodate Apr 7 or Apr 8 mornings PT — I'll pencil Apr 7 at 10:00 AM PT and send a calendar invite once Rishi confirms.

To your questions:
- Overage: We typically keep overage pricing as a separate line item. For this renewal, I’ve proposed a 10% reduction in the per-token overage rate for any usage beyond the expanded commit; it’s noted in the attached terms. We can make that explicit in the DocuSign package if needed.
- Term/early termination: The proposed one-year extension includes the standard 60-day notice for non-renewal and a prorated refund only in the rare event of a paid service outage beyond the SLA. The legal team can surface any clauses they want redlined — we’re happy to collaborate.

Ben — can you confirm the expected latency and throughput for the +20% commit with the model family they're on? I’ll draft a short mutual action plan after the scheduling is locked.

Cheers,
Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity increase & term questions — SignalStream

Hi all —

Quick technical note on the +20% commit: if the increased traffic is due to higher concurrent sessions (shorter requests at a higher rate), we should be able to satisfy the commit primarily via autoscaling and batching changes with negligible impact to tail latency. If instead you're seeing longer sequence lengths per request, the compute cost rises non-linearly — that would change optimizer recommendations.

Amy / Michael — can you confirm whether the usage delta is driven by more users or longer prompts? A simple histogram of sequence length over the last 30 days will help me pick the right kernel/quantization profile. I can prepare two capacity profiles (conservative / aggressive) for tomorrow's QBR.

Thanks,
Ben
Principal SE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
